title: console UI (area o1-B) loose ends: copy and doc-comment nits from landed reviews
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYRqkDAGuse5Wqbohi

Filing gate ① via the L1/L2 follow-up exception (`filing-gate.md`: p3 copy and doc nits go to the area's `<area> loose ends` card; none existed). Dedupe: `is:issue is:open "loose ends"` → 13 hits, none for the console UI area; `is:issue edit-app-load-failed`, `is:issue AppManagementPage "unknown error"`, `is:issue GroupRow "(empty)"` → only #35115 (the source of items 1-2) and closed, unrelated cards.

Later rounds append items here; ⛔ no separate card per nit.

## Items

- [ ] **1. EditAppPage load-failed sentence is hard-coded English** (`ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/pages/EditAppPage.tsx`, `edit-app-load-failed`), like the page's other strings. Needs a new locale key in every pack. From #35115 item N1 (L1 6969195748 on PR #35104); PR #35151 found no existing key that fits.
- [ ] **2. App management: an empty (null) authored read says "unknown error"** (`AppManagementPage`). A refused read already shows the server's message; only the null read lacks a sentence, which needs a new locale key. From #35115 item N2.
- [ ] **3. Two doc comments still say "(empty)"** after PR #35140 moved the empty group heading to `grid.empty`: `GroupRowProps.label` in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/GroupRow.tsx:17` (ships in the published `.d.ts`) and `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/temporalCellFace.ts:81`. From contract record 6972345919, N2.

## Why it matters

Items 1-2 show English or a vague "unknown error" to a zh-CN builder on the console's app pages; item 3 leaves a published type comment describing a label the grid no longer shows.

## Reader

Console UI lane (`domain:ui`), area o1-B of repo:objectstack#1, when p3 work resumes (p3 is paused by the maintainer); or any PR that next touches these files, which carries the item and ticks it.

Grading: p3 · copy and doc-comment nits (北极星 p3: review nits and tails).
